title: Surbhi Lohia – Accessibility Solutions Architect
description: Meet Surbhi Lohia, Solutions Architect and Accessibility SME at Ameratech.ai, leading inclusive web and AI accessibility solutions for enterprises.
body:
# Surbhi Lohia

Solutions Architect – Accessibility Subject Matter Expert

Surbhi Lohia is a Solution Architect and Accessibility Subject Matter Expert with 11+ years of experience advancing inclusive, accessible digital experiences across enterprise platforms. She specializes in global accessibility standards including WCAG, ADA, Section 508, and European accessibility requirements (EN 301 549), embedding accessibility by design through scalable, human-centered solutions.

Bringing both deep technical expertise and lived experience as a screen-reader user, Surbhi is a recognized advocate and thought leader who drives accessibility initiatives that deliver compliance, usability, and measurable business impact.
